hypotheses.H0_head_decomposition_is_exact: The nine native head VJPs recompose native attention with maximum relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.H1_discovery_rankings_are_stable: Panel-A versus panel-B score correlation is at least 0.5 and top-32 Jaccard at least 0.4 in every source layer.
hypotheses.H2_top32_is_high_fidelity: The averaged frozen top-32 edge program reaches median exact-gradient cosine at least 0.90 in every source layer.
hypotheses.H3_top32_is_causally_directional: Its top-64 channel interventions move positively on at least 95 percent of evaluation pairs in every source layer.
hypotheses.H4_top32_retains_near8_effect: It retains at least 85 percent of the full near-eight program's mean finite effect in every source layer.
hypotheses.H5_top16_is_not_universally_sufficient: Top 16 fails either 0.90 gradient cosine or 0.90 finite direction in at least one source layer.
hypotheses.H6_top32_beats_random: Frozen top 32 exceeds the random-32 p95 gradient cosine by at least 0.05 in every source layer.
